name: Emerald Armor Mod
summary: Adds emerald armor and emerald tools that sit below diamond, with Hero of the Village II on the helmet.
description:
Emerald Armor Mod adds a full set of emerald armor (helmet, chestplate, leggings, boots) and emerald tools (sword, pickaxe, axe, shovel, hoe) to Minecraft 1.20.1.

Balance sits just below diamond:
- Armor durability multiplier: 30 (diamond: 33)
- Armor protection: 2 / 5 / 6 / 2 (diamond: 3 / 6 / 8 / 3)
- Armor toughness: 1.0 (diamond: 2.0)
- Tool durability: 1400 (diamond: 1561)
- Tool mining speed: 7.0 (diamond: 8.0)
- Enchantability: 8 (diamond: 10)

Wearing the emerald helmet grants Hero of the Village II while equipped.

Available for Fabric, Forge, and NeoForge 1.20.1.
